tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Runs FirstPass Memo's 33 published red-flag rules on a small online-business listing (SaaS, content site, ecommerce, Amazon FBA, newsletter, app; roughly $10k-$150k) from Flippa, Empire Flippers, Acquire.com or any broker. Pass the listing text the user provides and/or the key numbers. Returns payba

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: Returns the 33 published rules the checker uses (code, title, group, severity, when it fires, explainer URL).
